_comment: One job per STRIP — the whole strip as one image, for the concept run. Run with comic_render.py --provider runway|google|openai.

jobs.title: The yellow slicker
jobs.prompt: a single full-page comic drawing (1 panels). Style: comic page, spare knowing ink line with soft watercolor in muted ochre, slate blue and misty sea-foam green, Pacific Northwest coastal light, economy of line, quiet composition. Title of the strip: ROFLCOPTER. The strip: A figure in a yellow rain slicker on the beach path in dry August, blue hair under the hood, from behind, and the crow going ahead of her along the wall. The only yellow the page has ever used. It doesn't ask. Panel 1: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a figure in a yellow rain slicker with blue curls showing under the hood walking a beach path seen from behind in dry August light, a crow flying ahead along a low wall, the slicker the only yellow on the page, no words. No text, no lettering, no speech balloons, no signature; leave clean space in each panel where balloons would go. Reference @loc_beach shows the setting; keep its architecture and props. Reference @chloe_44 is the model sheet for CHLOE: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Reference @gully_48 is the model sheet for GULLY: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Match the attached references: @loc_beach for the setting; @chloe_44 for the character the strip's Chloe at 44; @gully_48 for the character the strip's Gully at 41-48.
